topic: Tool of the Week — VS Code

slides.text: The one tool every developer on our team uses every single day
VS Code — the code editor built by Microsoft and trusted by millions of developers
slides.subtext: Fast, lightweight, and works on any operating system.

slides.text: Extensions for every language — JavaScript, Python, PHP, TypeScript, and more
slides.subtext: One editor. Every project. No switching tools.

slides.text: Built-in Git integration so you commit, push, and review code without leaving the editor
slides.subtext: Fewer windows open. More focus. Faster work.

slides.text: Live Share lets our whole team collaborate on the same file in real time
slides.subtext: Like Google Docs — but for code.

slides.text: IntelliSense autocomplete catches errors before they become bugs
slides.subtext: It pays attention so you do not have to remember everything.

slides.text: Free. Fast. Used by every serious developer. Download it today.
